blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Salah is the pillar of the Deen.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ آخِرُ كَلَامِ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلصَّلَاةَ اَلصَّلَاةَ اِتَّقُوا اللهَ فِيمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في حق المملوك رقم:٥١٥٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ali (RA) narrates that the final advice of the Prophet ﷺ was, “Salah! Salah! Fear Allah in the matter of your slaves and those under your care (fulfil the rights due to them).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَقْبَلَ مِنْ خَيْبَرَ وَمَعَهُ غُلَامَانِ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! أَخْدِمْنَا قَالَ: خُذْ أَيَّهُمَا شِئْتَ قَالَ: خِرْ لِي قَالَ: خُذْ هذَا وَلَا تَضْرِبْهُ فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّي مَقْفِلَنَا مِنْ خَيْبَرَ وَإِنِّي قَدْ نُهِيتُ عَنْ ضَرْبِ أَهْلِ الصَّلوةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه احمد والطبراني مجمع الزوائد:٤ /٤٣٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ returned after the battle of Khaibar. With him were two slaves. Hazrat Ali (RA) requested, “O Rasulullah! Give us a slave to serve us!” The Prophet ﷺ said, “Take whichever of these two you like!” When Hazrat Ali (RA) said, “Please choose one yourself and give him to me,” the Prophet ﷺ pointed towards one of the two and said, “Take this one! But do not beat him, because I saw him praying while we were returning from Khaibar, and I have been forbidden from beating those who pray.”
